crossRefs.note: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will…
Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t fear them, for I have delivered them into your hands. Not a man of them will stand before…
Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because Yahweh, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid because of them; for tomorrow at this time, I will deliver them up all slain…
“For Yahweh has driven great and strong nations out from before you. But as for you, no man has stood before you to…
One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is Yahweh your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.
When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies…
Yahweh said to Gideon, “There are still too many people. Bring them down to the water, and I will test them for you…
The children of Israel said to Samuel, “Don’t stop crying to Yahweh our God for us, that he will save us out of the…
Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised. It may…
and that all this assembly may know that Yahweh doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is Yahweh’s, and he…
I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved…
Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and…
God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
